ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 2015, as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019, and Executive Decreto No. 334 de 2018; Ley No. 52 de 2016 establishing the beneficial ownership information register at the Registro Público de Panamá; Código de Comercio (Unified Commercial Code); AML/CFT oversight by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or designated civil registry of the owner's country of origin, with notarial certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney authorizing the Panamanian resident agent to execute incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the owner's jurisdiction, submitted to the Panamanian resident agent via certified copy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent corporate existence document (if any shareholder is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian notary or foreign notary with specified authentication

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Autonomous Sanctions List, and Panama's domestic financial-terrorism and proliferation-financing targets. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are subject to enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. The resident agent must maintain documentary evidence of screening results for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sistema de Registro en Línea (SRL, Online Filing and Name Reservation Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be registered in Spanish or a foreign language using standard Latin script. Accents and special characters are generally omitted or transliterated phonetically. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and reservations for a period of two years. Documents relating to name clearance and the corporate name itself must be submitted in Spanish or accompanied by a certified Spanish translation when filed in Panama.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Gobierno de la República de Panamá
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must receive a formal written decision identifying the conflicting name or prohibited term. Within five business days of the rejection decision, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Dirección General del Registro Público de Panamá, accompanied by a new proposed name or supporting evidence of prior use/trademark rights. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may file a judicial review application before the Tercer Tribunal Civil del Primer Circuito Judicial de Panamá. A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days by filing a renewal request and paying the statutory fee, provided no conflicting name has been registered in the interim.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk online sales and light-assembly operation of wooden puzzles, provided the registered office is a physical Panamanian address, typically supplied by the licensed resident agent and capable of receiving legal process. A pure virtual or shell-office address may be accepted for non-licensed commercial activities but carries moderate scrutiny because the Company Law requires a designated physical address for service of process and tax correspondence. For ISIC 3240, no physical production facility is required in Panama if assembly and fulfillment occur through third-party suppliers or overseas logistics.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate. The estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Dirección General de Ingresos or the Registro Público during the first year is approximately 10%. The likelihood rises to 20–25% if the company maintains a nominal registered office without any responsive personnel or if recurrent suspicious reports are filed by financial institutions.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional legal fee for standard low-risk corporate formation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades de la Republica de Panama (Ley No. 32 de 1927, as consolidated and amended; including Articles 2, 5-10, 12, 14-16, 19, 23, 25, 30-34, 48-55 and Law 4 of 2017 concerning beneficial ownership transparency); complementary provisions of the Codigo Judicial and the Reglamento del Registro Publico.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Publico de Panama (Public Registry of Panama) - Direccion General del Registro, Mercantile Section / Sociedades Anonimas Desk, in coordination with the Ventanilla Unica de Empresas (VUE) under MICI.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Publica de Constitucion / Pacto Social de Sociedad Anonima, executed before a Panamanian notary and recorded in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required under Law 32 of 1927; the S.A. may be incorporated with authorized capital of as little as US$10,000.00 and shares issued at par without full payment. Paid-in funds are not required to be held in escrow for standard industrial companies; directors may set an installment schedule and record the paid portion in the corporate ledger.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CORPORATION], S.A. First board session. RESOLVED: 1) Share Subscription - the founding shareholders' subscription and partial payment of issued shares is ratified; directors set the installment calendar and record paid capital. 2) Registered Office - the official office at [address], Panama is adopted and the resident agent of record is ratified for statutory service of process. 3) Officers - the President, Secretary and Treasurer are appointed, with alternate officers, and are granted power to open bank accounts and execute contracts. 4) Authorization - officers are directed to file the corporate deed, obtain the RUC, municipal operating notice, fire clearance and environmental registration. Duly adopted, and the Secretary is instructed to publicize the minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability search and no-objection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Publico de Panama - Departamento de Certificados (online portal: elicencia / Registro Publico e-filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed corporate names in order of preference with a summary of the corporate purpose; pay the certificate tariff; obtain the 'Certificado de No Oposicion' confirming no conflicting registered trademark or company name.
required_dossiers: Application for certificate (solicitud de no oposicion)
Corporate purpose summary and three name options
Copy of applicant identification or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is objected, file a substituted name application or petition the registry director's reconsideration within five business days per Ley 38 de 2000.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of the Pacto Social / Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian licensed attorney acting as notary (abogado-notario)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the attorney to draft the full articles: corporate name, object (including ISIC 3240 manufacture and laser assembly of wooden puzzles), authorized capital, classes of shares, quorum and voting provisions, resident agent clause and initial officer structure.
required_dossiers: Resident agent consent letter from a Panamanian attorney or law firm
Statement of intended physical address for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Attorney circulates a corrected clean draft reconciling any conflicting clauses before execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders or their general proxies must appear before the notary, affirm the corporate purpose and capital, and sign the Escritura Publica de Constitucion; the notary assigns a protocol number and issues certified copies.
required_dossiers: Power-of-attorney documents if founders act remotely
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires correction, issue an amendment note (nota de enmienda) and re-execute the document before the same protocol.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Initial share subscription and paid-in capital record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company founders and board (book entry maintained in the corporate minute book)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Record the subscription of subscribed shares, issue share certificates and note the paid-in amount; if paid partly, set a call schedule. The paid-in capital may be deposited in a corporate bank account or retained per directors' resolution.
required_dossiers: Capital payment receipt or bank credit note
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Directors modify the installment schedule and file an amended subscription record to cure any capital contribution deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and registration at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Publico de Panama - Seccion Mercantil, payment and inscription window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Escritura Publica de Constitucion to the Mercantile Section; pay the registry tariff based on authorized capital and share count; registry examines the deed for legal compliance and records it, after which the inscription number and corporate docket (Ficha Registral) are issued.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any registry observation (reforma/reinscripcion) within thirty days, and file an administrative appeal per Ley 38 de 2000, Article 104, if the objection is contested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer registration (RUC) and corporate status with the DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos del Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas (via VUE single window: www.vue.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUC (Registro Unico de Contribuyente) application online, attach the inscribed deed and identify the territorial tax regime; obtain the RUC certificate and register for issuance of purchase invoices/resolutions for the laser assembly activity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI queries economic activity classification, clarify the ISIC 3240 industrial scope and re-file the amended application to correct the tax category.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal operating notice, fire clearance and employer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio del distrito (Alcaldia) via VUE/SUME portal; Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panama; CSS - Caja de Seguro Social; MITRADEL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the 'Aviso de Operacion' showing the physical address of the laser workshop; attach the fire inspection certificate and environmental registration; simultaneously register as employer with CSS and submit the occupational health notice to MITRADEL.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or title of the physical workshop
Fire safety certificate from Cuerpo de Bomberos
CSS employer registration form (Aviso de Empresa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal queries are cured by submitting updated fire clearance, corrected lease and revised environment registration; re-inspection may be requested within ten business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipio del distrito (Alcaldia) for the industrial Aviso de Operacion; Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) for environmental classification; no separate sectoral industrial license is imposed by MICI for ISIC 3240 toy manufacturing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operacion para Actividad Industrial / Licencia Comercial e Industrial (municipal business operation permit).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Direccion de Normas y Calidad Ambiental, Departamento de Evaluacion de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II (moderate impact) under Resolution AG-0613-2014; requires a 'Registro de Impacto Ambiental' (EIA Registration / Informe Ambiental) for the connected CO2 laser cutting and wood assembly workshop. Full EIA Report is not required for small-scale assembly operations unless production throughput exceeds the small-enterprise threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: Resolution AG-0288-2016 effluent limits - pH 6.5-8.5, BOD5 not to exceed 100 mg/L, COD not to exceed 300 mg/L, total suspended solids not to exceed 150 mg/L. Air emissions: Decree Exec. 694 of 2011 and Resolution AG-0188-2015 - no visible particulate or VOC plume; laser cutting units must be equipped with extraction and filtration; workplace respirable wood dust TWA not to exceed 5 mg/m3; ambient noise at property boundary not to exceed 80 dB(A).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panama covering extinguishers, evacuation routes, and Class-C suppression for the laser unit; structural load and occupancy review by the municipal building department (Curaduria); occupational health clearance and employer registration with MITRADEL (Direccion General de Riesgos Profesionales) per Decreto Ejecutivo 37 de 2010, including workplace design and ventilation verification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; official online portal: https://www.dgi.gob.pa and taxpayer self-service through the Sistema TIC@ e-services platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panama S.A., the foreign owner must: (1) incorporate the Sociedad Anónima with the Registro Público de Panamá and maintain a resident agent; (2) execute a sworn statement identifying the legal representatives; (3) submit the DGI application for inscription of legal persons, attaching the public registry certificate, corporate charter, resident agent appointment, officer passports/IDs, and proof of registered address; (4) obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes); (5) automatically be registered for ITBMS (VAT) through the same RUC process; and (6) file the Aviso de Operación with the DGI before commencing business. Non-resident shareholders are permitted and no minimum paid-in capital is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or partnership pass-through election exists for a Sociedad Anónima. Panama taxes the S.A. as a separate entity-level taxpayer on Panamanian-source income only. A qualifying exporter may apply to DGI for recognized exporter status to obtain export zero-rating certificates and consolidated refunds of ITBMS input credits. No hybrid mismatch election is available under Panamanian law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS - Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.0.00 — no turnover threshold. Any person carrying out a taxable activity in Panama must obtain RUC and register for ITBMS before starting operations; small taxpayers may be placed in the pequeño contribuyente simplified bracket but still require registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) is implemented by DGI through the Sistema de Facturación Electrónica de Panamá. Designated taxpayers, including mid-size and large exporters, must issue XML e-invoices using official schemas, sign each invoice digitally, transmit invoices to DGI in near-real time through the REST/API endpoints of TIC@ or the web portal, and obtain an official clearance status before delivery. Each accepted e-invoice must carry the DGI authorization code and a QR code. Invoices not transmitted or rejected are non-deductible and subject to fines.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Sales of tangible goods physically exported from Panama qualify for 0% ITBMS, including precision CO2-laser-cut 3D wooden puzzles assembled in Panama and sold through Amazon or Stripe to non-resident consumers. The goods must physically leave Panamanian territory within the applicable customs term and be delivered to the foreign buyer. Services are zero-rated only when rendered to non-resident clients and economically used abroad, without attachment to Panamanian real estate or tangible assets. ITBMS paid on taxable raw materials, packaging, laser consumables, and logistics inputs incurred to produce export goods is creditable or refundable against the zero-rated export transaction upon submission of the export evidence bundle.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera - DUA) accepted by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill naming the Panamanian exporter as shipper/consignor
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Inward remittance / SWIFT credit advice or payment provider settlement report evidencing receipt of foreign-currency payment from the non-resident buyer
E-commerce fulfillment documentation showing the final delivery destination outside Panama, such as Amazon logistics records or Stripe order summary
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI may cross-match export claims against ANA customs declarations, carrier manifests, courier delivery data, and banking or payment-rail records. False zero-rating, overstated export values, or undocumented exports are recharacterized as domestic taxable sales, resulting in ITBMS assessment, statutory late-payment interest, surcharges of up to 50% for intentional omission, monetary fines, and criminal liability for tax fraud. Retrospective clawbacks generally cover a five-year prescription period, and the exporter bears the full burden of proving physical export and receipt of foreign consideration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank issuing domestic currency; the banking regulator is the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), while the Ministry of Economy and Finance and Banco Nacional de Panamá (state-owned, performing fiscal agency and clearing functions) together provide monetary-liaison and treasury operations. The US dollar is legal tender under Panama's Currency Law.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system with no exchange controls. The Panamanian Balboa is a nominal monetary unit pegged 1:1 to the USD, circulating only as coins. Both capital account and current account transactions are freely convertible and remittable. There is no requirement for prior authorization on dividend distributions, capital repatriation, repayment of intercompany loans, royalties, or imported goods invoices. Profit remittance is unrestricted, but distributions must be supported by audited or reviewed financial statements and must respect Panama's territorial-source income tax rules for Panama-source earnings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no statutory timeline for repatriation of export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained in USD or any freely convertible currency, deposited in local or foreign bank accounts, and used for any lawful working capital or trade settlement purpose.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for Payroll and Trade Disbursements
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account and Trade Settlement Account
Operational Account and Liquidity Concentration Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Panama does not provide an 'electronic money institution' (EMI) license category; non-bank payment service providers must obtain a Payment Services Provider authorization from the SBP under the reformed banking framework. Offshore digital EMIs offering virtual IBANs cannot lawfully hold Panama corporate deposits or provide local clearing services without a licensed local presence or formal banking partnership. Offshore EMIs remain commercially useful only for aggregating Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement flows outside Panama, but all funds destined for the Panama entity must ultimately enter through a regulated Panama bank or a SBP-authorized payment provider to avoid AML/CFT compliance gaps.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners may complete onboarding using remote video identification and electronic signature under SBP AML norms, provided the corporate client is classified as low risk and the documentation is notarized and apostilled. In practice, leading Panamanian banks require at least one director, officer, or the appointed resident agent to appear in a documented video interview or physical visit for signature verification. A fully non-interactive, remote opening is rarely available for a non-resident owned S.A.; the standard mandate is a hybrid process: remote document review plus a short verification call, followed by physical signatory signature for critical account instructions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore entity with bearer shares or incomplete immobilization of shares
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Custody certificate from a licensed custodian evidencing share immobilization, certified share registry, articles of incorporation and bylaws, registered agent attestation and legal opinion confirming the company complies with Panama's bearer share rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in ultimate beneficial ownership or nominee director arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO declaration (Form UBO-1 or bank-specific form), organizational chart showing direct and indirect ownership, trust deed or foundation council resolution if applicable, sworn statements from nominees, certified passport copies and proof of residential address for all natural persons above the threshold.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparties or shareholders resident in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid tax residence certificates, economic substance documentation for the Panama company, evidence of commercial rationale for each counterparty, complete due diligence on the counterparty's own regulated status, and transaction flow descriptions with shipping and invoice supporting documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business activity mismatch or lack of physical substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Standard ISIC 3240 / NAICS 339930 classification certificate, commercial contracts with buyers and suppliers, warehouse or contract manufacturing agreements, equipment purchase invoices for CO2 laser cutters, website evidence, product catalogues, and monthly management accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High concentration of e-commerce settlement inflows without auditable trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement reports, payment processor KYC due diligence, intercompany or commission agreements, maintained sales ledger with customer invoices, refund policy, and accounting software audit logs.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions are remitted in USD via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's or ultimate parent's bank to the Panama S.A.'s designated capital escrow or operational account. The wire instruction must state the beneficiary company name, account number, and Panama RUC or tax ID; the purpose must be described as 'Aporte de Capital / Capital Contribution' to facilitate the bank's AML review. Because Panama has no exchange control, no central bank approval is required, but the receiving bank will require the capital subscription resolution, an updated paid-in share register, source-of-funds evidence, and, where the shareholder is a Panama Private Interest Foundation, the foundation council instruction and final beneficiary statement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade payments for raw material imports, machinery spare parts, and outsourced laser cutting materials clear through the Panama treasury account using SWIFT MT103 direct transfers. For larger or contractually secured purchases, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) is used, with documents covering transport, insurance, and quality inspection. Payment descriptions must accurately state 'Trade Payment for Raw Materials / Production Equipment'. Settlement from Amazon Pay and Stripe is received in USD through the processors' settlement bank and credited to the Panama operational account, after which funds are allocated internally to supplier payment, payroll clearing, and corporate cost accounts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards in USD/CNH and USD/EUR executed with international Tier-1 banking counterparties
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/CNY for procurement contracts where onshore deliverable hedging is unavailable to Panama resident companies
Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR/CNH for treasury liquidity and intercompany liability management
Currency options (calls and puts) on USD/EUR and USD/CNH for transactional protection; no Panama stamp duty or FX licensure applies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Panama Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 15 June under the Panama Tax Code.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly statutory interest (currently 1%) plus penalty up to 10% of the tax; failure for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off by the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales / Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 15 June, concurrent with the franchise tax; updates required within 15 days of any share transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from USD 500 to USD 5,000; possible suspension of the company's standing in the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) – Nil filing for offshore income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Panama Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of the year following the fiscal year end (calendar-year fiscal year).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of tax due or flat administrative fine if nil; interest accrues; repeated failures may activate presumptive assessment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit under the Panama Tax Code if annual gross income exceeds USD 1,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 1,000,000; regulated sectors (banks, insurers, fiduciaries) are always audited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB (mandatory for listed and regulated entities); IFRS for SMEs (permitted for private S.A. companies).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent maintains a confidential Beneficial Ownership Register; annually, the company files a UBO confirmation with the DGI (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) on or before 15 June. Share transfers are recorded in the Register of Members and in a notarised share transfer instrument; the UBO form is updated within 15 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $650 – $1,200 (annual registered agent, registered address, and document filing services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $2,500 – $5,000 (full audit for a small low-risk entity; no audit fee if exemption applies)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat statutory corporate rate; from fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025, Law 365 of 2024 introduces a progressive scale of 19% on the first B/.50,000 of taxable income, 25% on the next B/.50,000, and a 27% marginal rate on taxable income exceeding B/.100,000.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territoriality regime under Article 694 of the Código Fiscal excludes genuinely foreign-source income from the ISR base. No general sectoral holiday exists for non-licensed educational toy manufacturing; a 5% corporate rate is available only for qualifying multinational regional headquarters under the SEM regime (Ley 41 de 2007). Municipal patent and operating fees apply at district level. Net operating losses may be carried forward for five fiscal years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 1201 — Declaración Jurada Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta, filed exclusively through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) electronic platform 'e-Tax 2.0' (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance income tax payments (anticipos) are due on or before 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December of the active fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return is due by 31 March of the year following the fiscal year-end (within three months after the close of the fiscal year for non-calendar-year taxpayers).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC number, verification digit, fiscal year covered, and full corporate name of the Sociedad Anónima.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the RUC granted at incorporation and the local fiscal representative details; the S.A. is a Panamanian resident taxpayer, not a non-resident filer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Primary economic activity code for precision CO2 laser cutting and assembly of 3D mechanical wooden puzzles.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report ISIC 3240 (manufacture of toys and games) and NAICS 339930; confirm the industrial operation is physically situated in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3a — Ingresos por ventas de bienes y operaciones en plaza local
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panamanian-source revenue from wholesale and direct-to-consumer sales settled through Amazon Pay, Stripe, bank deposits, and other collection rails.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all payments of Panamanian origin and all export sales manufactured in Panama; territoriality does not exclude profits from goods produced by an industrial enterprise located in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs: raw wood boards, laser consumables and gases, electricity, rent, wages and Social Security quotas, Amazon marketplace fees, freight, and depreciation of laser cutting and assembly equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support each deduction with supplier invoices, payroll records, and payment-settlement statements; expenses lacking commercial substance or not recorded in Panama books are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income after permitted deductions and the statutory five-year net operating loss carryforward, adjusted for non-deductible provisions and transfer-pricing corrections.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile to the financial statements held in Panama; retain the detailed computation annex for DGI audit inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISR computed by applying the statutory corporate rate to taxable net income; for fiscal years starting 2025, apply the Law 365 progressive brackets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Utilize treaty tax credits only where a DTA in force grants a credit; no unilateral credit exists for foreign taxes on Panamanian-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly advance payments and source withholdings previously credited against the annual ISR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile anticipos with DGI payment acknowledgements; overpayments generate a refundable credit or carry-forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 11 — Saldo a pagar o a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable to the National Treasury or credit balance to be refunded or applied; settlement is executed within the e-Tax portal by debit or bank deposit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay in USD/Balboas by the statutory deadline; non-payment triggers moratory interest and denial of the Paz y Salvo certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is penalized with a 10% surcharge on the tax payable plus statutory monthly moratory interest on the outstanding amount; late payment accrues monthly interest until extinction; persistent non-filing after DGI 15-day notices activates enforced collection (bank embargo and auction of assets) and suspension of the taxpayer's compliance certificate.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed from earnings that already bore Panamanian ISR (Código Fiscal Article 735); 20% on dividend distributions paid from earnings not previously subjected to Panamanian corporate income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must deliver to the paying Sociedad Anónima a current, apostilled Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the jurisdiction of residence confirming beneficial ownership; the Panamanian payer applies the treaty-reduced dividend rate at source, preserves the TRC and supporting beneficial-ownership declaration in the corporate file, and reports the reduced withholding in the DGI e-Tax 2.0 retention schedule; upon audit, relief is upheld only if the recipient is the true beneficial owner and the TRC is valid for the entire fiscal year of distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties, technical-service fees, and similar payments for the use of intellectual property made to non-residents carry a statutory 12.5% withholding, reducible under applicable DTAs (commonly to 5–10% for beneficial-owner royalties); interest on foreign loans of a Panamanian debtor carries a statutory 5% withholding, with treaty reductions customarily to 5% or nil, subject to TRC presentation and anti-abuse review.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory contemporaneous Transfer Pricing documentation (Local File) and an annual related-party transaction declaration apply when the taxpayer's gross annual income exceeds B/.3,000,000 (Balboas at par with the US dollar) and controlled cross-border transactions exist; a Master File is required at group level where consolidated group revenue exceeds USD 750 million, consistent with the OECD Country-by-Country scope.
